decisions.rationale: “The joystick was in manual mode” is supported by state-joy_priority=true and the supplied semantics identifying that indicator with manual mode. This state assertion does not itself assert duration or physical inhibition; the separate causal assertion lacks support.

“The joystick was in manual mode” conveys the supported manual-selection diagnostic using the supplied indicator semantics. The unsupported causal connection is evaluated separately and does not erase communication of that state.
